**What's the workflow this would help with?**

Describe the actual shell-script task you're trying to do, not just the
feature — this project's bar for new features is "does this survive
actually building something with it during 30–60 minutes of real use,"
so the concrete workflow matters more than the abstract feature idea.
See `.claude/steering/product.md` for the project's scope philosophy.

**What you'd like to happen**

A clear description of the feature.

**Have you checked whether this is already a known, deliberate gap?**

`.claude/steering/product.md` lists several things that are intentionally
deferred (a full bash parser / multi-line construct handling, undo/redo,
ShellCheck integration, non-bash executors, config files) along with why
and what the eventual right design looks like. If your request is one of
these, it's still worth filing — it helps prioritize — but please
mention you've seen the note rather than re-proposing the same thing from
scratch.

**Alternatives considered**

Any workaround you're currently using, or other approaches you thought
about.
